author: Mathiesin
quote:
The game is awful…. This is dating simulator and Lucia is awful. I hate what this is. The characters are forgettable and the story…. What happened to GTA!?

The writing is bad, the characters ****, and it’s a washed down version of what once was. To call this a GTA game is false advertising!! If you like being a cuck, and enjoy advanced “The Sims dating simulator”, this is for you. I’m throwing this game in the trash.
